context: SIS Demo — Okta AS configuration required for MCP + DCR integration

scopes.name: sis.admin
scopes.description: Full read/write access to all student data across all categories. Bypasses all per-category scope checks.

scopes.name: sis.students.read
scopes.description: Read access to core student profile records (name, enrollment, contact info).

scopes.name: sis.students.write
scopes.description: Create, update, and delete core student profile records. Implicitly includes read.

scopes.name: sis.students.read.self
scopes.description: Allows a student to read their own profile via /api/v1/students/me. Cannot access other students.

scopes.name: sis.students.ferpa
scopes.description: Access to FERPA waiver status, directory information opt-out, authorized release parties, and FERPA holds. Enrollment Counselor persona only.
scopes.dcr_note: Agent acting on behalf of Enrollment Counselor receives this scope via token exchange; Student Affairs agents must NOT receive it.

scopes.name: sis.students.financial
scopes.description: Access to financial aid status, aid package breakdown, EFC, outstanding balance, scholarships, and financial holds.
scopes.dcr_note: Agent acting on behalf of Enrollment Counselor receives this scope via token exchange; Student Affairs agents must NOT receive it.

scopes.name: sis.students.ada
scopes.description: Access to ADA accommodation types, diagnosis category (broad), documentation status, and assigned coordinator.
scopes.dcr_note: Agent acting on behalf of Student Affairs receives this scope; Enrollment Counselor agents must NOT receive it.

scopes.name: sis.students.disciplinary
scopes.description: Access to disciplinary incident history including type, outcome, sanctions, appeals, and hearing officer.
scopes.dcr_note: Agent acting on behalf of Student Affairs receives this scope; Enrollment Counselor agents must NOT receive it.

scopes.name: sis.students.counselor
scopes.description: Access to academic and guidance counselor notes, follow-up status, and counselor type (academic/guidance/career).
scopes.dcr_note: Agent acting on behalf of Student Affairs receives this scope; Enrollment Counselor agents must NOT receive it.

scopes.name: sis.students.risk
scopes.description: Access to GPA, GPA trend, attendance rate, missed assignments, failing courses, academic probation flag, and intervention flags.
scopes.dcr_note: Agent acting on behalf of Student Affairs receives this scope; Enrollment Counselor agents must NOT receive it.

scopes.name: sis.students.academic
scopes.description: Access to major/minor, academic standing, GPA, credit hours, expected graduation, advisor, full transcript, and current courses.
scopes.dcr_note: Agent acting on behalf of Student Affairs receives this scope; Enrollment Counselor agents must NOT receive it.

standard.note: Okta user ID of the human caller

scopes_claim.note: API checks scp array first, then scope string. Okta custom AS emits scp as array by default — no change needed.

custom_required.required_for: Student self-service lookup (/me endpoint) and agent identity resolution
custom_required.note: Must be added to the custom AS token via a profile mapping claim. Maps to Okta profile.email.
custom_required.okta_action: Add 'email' claim to the custom AS access token policy — value expression: user.email

custom_required.note: Okta emits this automatically as the OAuth client_id. No action needed.

dcr_access_control_matrix.description: Scope sets granted per persona via DCR token exchange. The agent's token must be bounded by the human caller's granted scopes.

scope_consent_metadata.note: All scopes are consent=IMPLICIT for this demo (no end-user consent prompt). Set on each scope in the Okta AS.
scope_consent_metadata.metadata_endpoint_advertising: All 11 scopes are advertised in the live PRM at https://sis-api.skylarbarnes.com/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource

env_vars.AGENT_TOKEN_SCOPE: sis.students.read sis.students.write sis.students.ferpa sis.students.financial sis.students.ada sis.students.disciplinary sis.students.counselor sis.students.risk sis.students.academic sis.admin openid
